Frozen status.py uses token_count totals: these understate the reconciled per-response totals in completed runs and reset by turn on measured-004 continuation. Use the per-response sums validated against final thread_token_usage for reporting.
Setup/supervision usage is excluded; its aggregate is unavailable in these run logs.
Subscription token usage is not a dollar invoice.
